retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-inspired layout featuring a central rounded-corner photo framed by dense, repetitive sans-serif typography and a double-line border.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover with repetitive text border
mid-century blue and yellow graphic layout
excludeWhen: designs requiring script or serif fonts

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a deep blue field, containing a central photographic window with heavily rounded corners. The layout is defined by a thin yellow double-line border and a rhythmic repetition of a single phrase in light blue and yellow sans-serif type that fills the negative space around the image.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic subject framed by a thick typographic border
High-contrast yellow display text against a dark blue background
Repetitive vertical columns of text creating a texture rather than just readability
Rounded rectangular geometry echoed in both the frame and the photo window
coreInvariants: Double-line yellow border following the outer edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group photograph is centered, occupying approximately 60% of the total area, framed within a rounded rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow lowercase display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow title, move down to the horizontal text bar, then circulate through the repetitive text columns surrounding the central image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue background acts as the negative space, but is largely filled with repetitive typographic patterns.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright lemon yellow for primary text and borders
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light sky blue for repetitive secondary text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow against low-value blue creates a vibrant, pop-art contrast.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a simple open loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same sans-serif family, using color to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider bar with alternating text colors

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the narrow, sturdy feel of the repetitive side text.
Captures the geometric lowercase display style of the 1960s.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid navy blue square background. In the center, place a vertical rectangular photo of a group of people on a brick staircase, applying a heavy corner radius to the photo so it looks like a pill-shape or a very rounded rectangle. Add a thin yellow double-line border around the entire outer edge of the square.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large bold yellow lowercase sans-serif text at the top. Below it, add a horizontal bar containing all-caps sans-serif text in alternating white and sky blue. Fill the left and right margins with vertical columns of small, repetitive sky-blue lowercase sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the main title in lowercase yellow sans-serif?
Are the corners of the central photo heavily rounded?
Is the background a consistent navy blue?
Does the repetitive text form vertical columns on the sides?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the central image
Density of the repetitive text columns
Thickness of the yellow outer border
Color of the secondary repetitive text
mustRedesign: The specific faces in the photograph
The record label logo in the bottom right

mustAchieve: High-contrast blue and yellow color scheme

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite repetition
Check that the yellow border is continuous and follows the square edge
Verify the photo is correctly masked with rounded corners
Confirm the color palette is limited to blue, yellow, and white
recipe.reuseFormula: Navy blue background + rounded-corner photo inset + repetitive sans-serif side columns + bold lowercase yellow header.
